correctness.rationale: All five proved components checked line by line. (A) Root is the unique infinite-degree vertex so every automorphism fixes it; each top subtree T_i is a rooted full binary tree, so fixing isomorphisms T_i~=B gives abstract isomorphism G~=(prod H) rtimes Sym(N) with the stated permutational action, and the product/pointwise topologies match the pointwise-convergence topology with K=H^N compact normal and S_infty closed; the conjugation formula (*) was rederived from (l,tau)^{-1}=(x,tau^{-1}), x_i=l_{tau(i)}^{-1} and the index computation is correct. (B) Finite wreath class lemma c->c(c+1)/2+c verified: (-,0) classes are unordered pairs of F-classes giving binom(c+1,2), swap classes are classified by the conjugacy class of the cyclic product ab with every class attained (b=1), so exactly c; the recursion c_0=1 gives 1,2,5,20,230 with orders 1,2,8,128,32768. The audit reran verify_wreath.py and reproduced (|H_n|,classes)=(1,1),(2,2),(8,5),(128,20) for n<=3 with recursion and order identities matching at every step. Profinite completeness of I_H(x)=([pi_n(x)])_n uses only nonempty finite fibers F_n with compatible restrictions, so compactness/Konig gives a thread conjugating x to y; I_H is continuous hence Borel, invariant under H-conjugacy. (C) Z-orbit vanishing: equation (**) h'_{j_m}=l_{j_m} h_{j_m} l_{j_{m-1}}^{-1} is solved from an arbitrary seed by the stated forward/backward recursions, both verified; per-orbit independence covers countably many Z-orbits; sigma in S_infty indeed has only finite and bi-infinite orbits. (D) Cyclic-product telescoping P_O(h')=l P_O(h) l^{-1} checked with l_{j_{-1}}=l_{j_{k-1}}; the cyclic-closure converse (set l_{j_{k-1}}=u and solve cyclically) is correct because conjugacy of the cyclic products is exactly the closing condition; centralizer permutes equal-length cycles and rotates within cycles, so per-length multisets of H-classes are complete; the sigma=id specialization h'_i=l_i h_{tau^{-1}(i)} l_i^{-1} follows from (*), giving the multiset-equivalence Borel reduction. (E) Countable side: with countably many H-classes the invariant (finitary cycle type counts m_k plus per-length multiplicity functions into N cup {infty}) lands in a standard Borel space, is Borel computed and complete by sections 4-5. Continuum side: smooth H-conjugacy with continuum many classes Borel-embeds =_{2^N} via the quoted uncountable-analytic-image-contains-Cantor-set fact (a standard descriptive-set-theoretic step, flagged as quoted background), then infinite-repetition coding z_{<n,k>}=x_n (each value multiplicity 0 or infinity) reduces =^+ to the identity fiber by section 5, so G-conjugacy is =^+-hard hence non-smooth by quoted Friedman-Stanley =<_B=^+. The report explicitly withholds which side holds and separates computed evidence from conjecture, so no overclaim. Distinction proof-vs-evidence: (A)-(D) and the conditional (E) are proofs; the brute-force check is evidence for the lemma at levels<=3 only, as honestly stated; the continuum-side embedding and =^+ facts are quoted background, not proved here.
